title: A+ Content — Basic A+
desc: A clean modular A+ layout focused on product benefits, feature hierarchy and easy scanning.
challenge: Turn product information into a clear visual story within a structured A+ module system.
approach: Built a repeatable content hierarchy around benefits, product features and proof points.
process: Content hierarchy → visual system → module design → responsive QA
deliverables: Basic A+ · Product Infographics · Feature Graphics

title: Premium A+ — Product Story
desc: A premium A+ direction using larger visual storytelling moments and stronger brand expression.
challenge: Create a richer product story while maintaining fast comprehension.
approach: Combined large-format visuals, benefit-led modules and a consistent brand system.
process: Brand study → story map → module composition → final system
deliverables: Premium A+ · Brand Storytelling · Comparison Graphics

title: Enhanced Brand Content — EBC
desc: A conversion-oriented EBC concept focused on product education and brand clarity.
challenge: Present product differentiation without creating visual overload.
approach: Used strong hierarchy, concise messaging and product-led visual modules.
process: Product audit → messaging → visual hierarchy → final modules

title: Brand Story — Brand X
desc: A visual brand-story system connecting the company story with its product portfolio.
challenge: Make the brand feel human while keeping the story commercially useful.
approach: Structured the story around identity, values and product relationships.
process: Brand discovery → story architecture → visual direction → modules
deliverables: Brand Story · Brand Visual System · Product Portfolio

title: Amazon Storefront — Brand Y
desc: A storefront concept designed to organize products into clear shopping journeys.
challenge: Turn a product catalog into a navigable, branded experience.
approach: Created category hierarchy, collection logic and consistent visual modules.
process: Catalog mapping → UX structure → visual system → page design
deliverables: Storefront Design · Category Pages · Product Collections

title: Listing Images — Product Y
desc: A complete listing-image direction combining product clarity, benefits and lifestyle context.
challenge: Communicate the strongest purchase reasons within a fast-scanning image sequence.

process: Product audit → image sequence → infographic system → QA

title: Product Visual System
desc: A reusable product visual system for feature, benefit and comparison communication.
challenge: Make technical product details accessible without losing visual polish.
approach: Translated specifications into visual comparison, feature and benefit modules.
process: Specification audit → visual translation → comparison system → delivery

desc: A minimal identity direction for a modern creative studio.

title: E-commerce Landing Page
desc: A focused landing-page concept connecting product storytelling with a clean digital experience.

title: Product Launch Film
desc: A short-form product film direction using motion, pacing and graphic composition.

title: Electrical SLD Documentation

process: Requirement review → diagram structure → drafting → documentation QA
